topic: Luffy rejected the newspaper story about Sabo on sight, and it says something specific about their bond
title: Luffy Rejected The Sabo Newspaper Story Instantly
description: Luffy read the paper that blamed Sabo and flatly refused to believe it in chapter 1060. I think that refusal is built on one earlier scene in Dressrosa. Was it faith or stubbornness?
comment: Was Luffy's refusal pure faith in Sabo, or is it just Luffy being stubborn? Pick one.

lines.text: Luffy read the paper that blamed Sabo, and he didn't believe a single word.

shot.fallback: boy in a straw hat glaring at a newspaper

lines.text: Chapter 1060. No proof, no explanation, just a flat no.

shot.fallback: straw hat boy shaking his head angrily

lines.text: People say that's just Luffy being Luffy. I think it's more specific than that.

shot.fallback: straw hat boy smiling at a blond man

lines.text: In Dressrosa, Luffy didn't even recognize Sabo until he named the day they became brothers.

shot.fallback: two men embracing in an arena

lines.text: Then Luffy cried, because he had believed Sabo was gone for more than a decade.

shot.fallback: boy in a straw hat crying with joy

lines.text: Here's the detail people miss. That reunion taught Luffy what Sabo stands for before any newspaper could.

shot.fallback: blond man looking at the sea with determination

lines.text: The wiki says Luffy has great faith in Sabo's ideals, in fighting for freedom.
Some fans say Luffy is just stubborn. But stubborn doesn't pick the right side.

shot.fallback: straw hat boy clenching his fist

lines.text: His belief isn't about facts. It's about a person he already paid for in tears.

shot.fallback: two brothers hugging after years apart

lines.text: And that's why Sabo never needs to defend himself to Luffy.

shot.fallback: blond man smiling at his brother

lines.text: So who does Sabo actually need to hide the truth from?

shot.fallback: blond man hiding in a dark corridor

lines.text: Because Luffy read that paper and didn't believe a single word...

shot.fallback: straw hat boy tearing a newspaper

self_check.hook: Luffy and Sabo named in line 1 with a concrete refusal
self_check.loop: last line leads back into line 1
